receipt_required.artifacts: absolute artifact path to SHA256; exactly one .mjs, exactly one .wasm; include generated/path_catalogue.json and other generated file identities
receipt_required.source_closure: repository-relative path to SHA256; complete actual compiler/schema/C++/generator/CMake/model dependencies

binding.cases: nonempty repository-relative frozen case/reference/policy map to SHA256
binding.results: nonempty repository-relative saved results map to SHA256

independent_build_review_required.reviewer_run: actual separate reviewer run, different from qualification implementation_run

package_cases.cases: each has id, complete standard path request and expected array matching engine points including initial; expected points include context.state all five entries and observables.stress all six Mandel entries
package_cases.source: reuse independently frozen Cartesian matrix references; no new reference campaign

notes: No material execution is performed by the builder.
Builder regenerates path_catalogue.json, path_models.hpp and path_api.cpp and requires exact equality to provided build generated files.
All source_closure and qualification case/result digests are checked against current coherent source tree before packaging.
Actual runtime package and browser qualification remain coordinator-owned.
